name: Shopify agentic commerce (UCP MCP servers)
summary: Shopify's documented path for AI agents to buy on a person's behalf: UCP-compliant MCP servers for catalog search across every Shopify merchant, carts and checkouts at each merchant's own endpoint, and orders, plus a UCP CLI and an AI Toolkit skill. Three access tiers in the vendor's words: Token (a Dev Dashboard credential), Signed (RFC 9421 signatures) and Anonymous (nothing). Catalog search needs no account (measured). Measured 2026-09-20 at one merchant: of 13 tools only complete_checkout and get_order refuse an anonymous caller; no valid checkout was attempted.

payments.notes: 2026-09-20: no page read prices agent access to these servers and no 402 protocol is spoken; the tiers gate on identification and rate limits. The money here is the buyer's purchase at the merchant, which this block does not model. Any cost behind the Token tier's credential was not established.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-20 18:04Z at one merchant's endpoint, no credential or signature: 11 of 13 tools take an anonymous call and answer an argument error; complete_checkout and get_order answer 403 AuthenticationRequired. No valid call made. 2026-09-11: catalog search 200 with a profile, 422 without.

jobs.summary: Vendor's agents docs: build commerce agents that act on behalf of buyers over the Universal Commerce Protocol, from catalog discovery through carts, checkouts, buyer hand-off and order tracking. Claim only: catalog search was measured without an account; no cart, checkout or purchase was made.
